app_fee.value: The application fee is $75 for degree programs; the Biostatistics PhD is applied for through SOPHAS with its own fee.
app_fee.quote: The non-refundable application fee is currently $75 for degree or certificate programs

fee_waiver.value: Graduate School fee waivers go only to applicants in named US access programs such as CSTEP and HEOP; international applicants are not eligible.
fee_waiver.quote: International and SOPHAS applicants are not eligible

gre_general.value: Each program sets its own GRE rule; see the program record.

toefl_min.value: The general TOEFL internet minimum is 4.0 on the new 2026 scale (79 on the old iBT scale).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL internet exam: 79 or 4.0 (new 2026 scoring system)

ielts_min.quote: TOEFL paper exam: 550 IELTS: 6.5 Duolingo English exam: 110

english_waiver.value: Four full-time semesters with a B average at a US or approved-list college waive the test. India is not named on the fetched pages, so the approved list must be checked.
english_waiver.quote: successfully completed at least four full-time semesters within a four-year time frame from time of application and maintained at least a B average at a college or university in the United States or a country from an approved list

also.quote: If you attended an institution where instruction was conducted in English and your transcript is in English, then that transcript is sufficient. | However, you must also provide official documentation on the language of instruction.

notes: Program list from the graduate programs page (https://www.albany.edu/graduate/graduate-programs). Not saved (not in fields.json): Climate Science PhD and Environmental Health Sciences, Epidemiology PhD (CIHS, SOPHAS); Nanoscale Engineering and Nanobioscience PhDs (CNSE, the same rules as Nanoscale Science); Economics, Psychology and other non-STEM PhDs.
